shortDescription: Manages REST operations on devices running Enterprise SONiC

options.name: body
options.description: The body of the HTTP request/response to the web service which contains the payload.

options.name: method
options.description: The HTTP method of the request or response. Must be a valid method accepted by the service that handles the request.

options.name: status_code
options.description: A list of valid, numeric, HTTP status codes that signifies the success of a request.

options.name: url
options.description: The HTTP path of the request after 'restconf/'.
